title: SF471 (2025-2026 Regular): Dangerous weapons in public libraries prohibition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-17; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/471/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed 2025-01-17; no votes recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1i): (b) Except as provided under paragraphs (c) and (d), whoever knowingly possesses, stores, or keeps a dangerous weapon while inside a public library building is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1i): (c) Notwithstanding paragraph (b), it is a misdemeanor for a person authorized to carry a firearm under the provisions of a permit or otherwise to carry a firearm on or about the person's clothes or person inside a public library building. Notwithstanding section 609.531, a firearm carried in violation of this paragraph is not subject to forfeiture.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1i): (d) This subdivision does not apply to licensed peace officers.
